critique: The cloudlet class delivers under the curve master: t1 shows soft puffs birthing along the bottom; t4 a towering connected white smoke bank filling most of the frame — cauliflower billows with internal shading, volume from overlapping low-opacity cloudlets, zero hard particle edges. Clear rise and spread between frames. (Emitter Size Y/Z stayed gated on the clone — harmless, X-width carried the band.) Would satisfy as-is.
